    SPACE EXPLORER

    Hi, Explorer! I'm Zippy. Let's fly through the Solar System!

    HOW TO PLAY

    • Fly: Arrow keys or W A S D. On a phone or with a mouse, drag or move to steer your ship.
    • Collect: ⭐ stars give 10 points and 💎 crystals give 25. Space rocks ☄️ take away a heart.
    • Quiz missions: Tap the answer you think is right. Don't worry, you learn something new every time!
    • Hints: In Find the Planet, fewer clues means more points.
    • Levels: Finish a mission to win ★ stars and unlock the next mission and a new planet.
    • Other keys: P = pause. Use the top buttons to mute, restart or go back.
